title: notif callback line
description: One line of .devcontainer/tmp/logs/notif-actions.jsonl, appended by the notif binary (CallbackPayload in notif-core callback.rs) when the user interacts with a banner sent with --on-action ...:file:<path>. A line without `v` is today's format; `v` is 1 when present.

notif_id.description: The --id the banner was sent with (the queue line's notif_id).

event.description: click | dismiss | timeout | action:<label>. Only action:Allow is acted on today.
